payload.summary: teaching_command('display.revoke') authorisation guard passes when display link created_by is NULL
payload.detail: supabase/migrations/20260926225609_teaching_mode.sql:1473 uses 'if not (v_link.created_by = p_actor_id or v_role = organiser) then raise'. created_by is nullable (on delete set null), so NULL or false is NULL and the raise never fires: a non-organiser can revoke a link whose creator was deleted. The same pattern was repaired in two other functions by a null-guards migration. Next action (needs an approved migration window, a Supabase migration reaches the live clinical database on merge): coalesce(v_link.created_by = p_actor_id, false) is not true and v_role <> 'organiser'. Fix before the teaching surface opens.
